use: Deposit droplets on a solid surface and measure the static contact angle (wettability) with a camera.
simulation: Contact angle from liquid surface tension and solid surface energy via Young's equation / empirical model, plus image-measurement noise.
notes: RAISE-style contact-angle imaging: stepped stage (5 tiers × 9 spots) + flat-panel LED backlight + pick-and-place USB camera + contour image processing. Custom-built.
sources: Nazeri et al., RAISE, Digital Discovery 2025 (arXiv 2510.06546): system SD 0.805°, tier offsets Table S2, ~1 measurement/min

comms.protocol: OpenCV USB capture + image processing (RAISE open-source code)

read.description: Read the latest imaging result (imaging is triggered by OT-2 image_droplets)

alternatives.model: custom Staircase stage + pick-up USB camera (RAISE-style)
